metadata.description: Wire format for `GET /v1/packages/{group}/{name}`: one package's usable full catalog entries and refused versions. Source of truth for the writer: `crates/vibe-index/src/server/routes/packages.rs` (`PackageVersionsResponse`, `package_versions`); the generated reader lives in `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index_http/e1/package_versions_response/`.
The package kind read from a usable version, or null when the usable set is empty. Always present; kept as a nullable string until codegen supports nullable open-vocabulary refs.
The newest usable non-prerelease version, or null when none exists. Always present.
Every full catalog entry this build can act on, in ascending version order. The elements reuse the registered `index-entry` shape instead of minting a duplicate.
Versions this build refuses, absent when none exist.
One package version this build refuses and the recovery recipe, mirroring `crates/vibe-index/src/index/quarantine.rs::Unavailable`.
The refused version's bare package name.
Reader capabilities unknown to this build, in record order.
The generated explanation and fix surface for the refusal.
